## 所有素材包免费 · Every theme pack is now free

- 精品素材包和森林玻璃对所有人免费开放，不再需要激活码。
  Premium packs and the Forest glass theme are free for everyone — no license key needed.
- 素材包商店可以点开大图预览仪表盘效果，再决定下载。
  Click a pack in the store to preview the full dashboard before downloading.

## 支持作者 · Support the author

- 设置页和素材包商店顶部新增「支持作者」卡片，可用微信或支付宝打赏；也可以在命令面板运行 **Support the author**。
  A "Support the author" card at the top of Settings and the theme pack store, with WeChat Pay and Alipay tip codes. Also available as the **Support the author** command.

- 英文界面下素材包显示英文名称。 Theme pack names show in English when the interface is in English.
